headline: Sammaan Capital Limited: Timely Interest Payment on Listed Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures
sum: Sammaan Capital Limited certified to NSE that it has made timely payment of interest on its Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures issued via public issue and listed on stock exchanges. The certification was filed under SEBI Regulation 57 of the Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.
detail: Sammaan Capital Limited, an NBFC, issued Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures (SRNCDs) through public offering and listed them on the stock exchanges. On 22 June 2026, the company filed a certification with the NSE confirming that all interest payments on these debentures had been made on schedule, as mandated by SEBI's Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements (LODR) Regulations, 2015. This filing evidences the company's covenant compliance and operational debt-servicing stability.
